unique.reason: Real known issue: jumping to #email scrolls the input to the top, hiding its label, hint and inline error above it. Focus claim slightly overstated, but the burden is real for magnifier users.
Title is never prefixed with Error and inline message has no Error prefix, so it can read as hint text. Real, minor, since summary focus is also provided.
Correct: hidden element referenced by aria-describedby keeps stale text and is still computed. Window is short (valid submit navigates), so minor.
Speculative: success and server pages are not in the material; reviewer admits impact is not established. Generic advice, not a finding in this file.
Not a problem in this material; explicitly a hypothetical risk about future adapted versions with nothing dropped or wrong now.
